name: Stepwise UI

components.name: Button
components.summary: Squircle button in three sizes and five variants.

demo.peerNotes: Install via `npx stepwise-ui add {slug}`. Requires React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript. Registry JSON at https://ui.stepwise.studio/r/{slug}.json.

components.copyCode:
npx stepwise-ui add button

import { Button } from '@/components/stepwise/button'

<Button variant="solid">Ship it</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use Stepwise UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://ui.stepwise.studio/docs/button. Install with `npx stepwise-ui add button` (writes source into `components/stepwise/`; registry https://ui.stepwise.studio/r/button.json). Import from `@/components/stepwise/button`. Peers commonly include motion, clsx, tailwind-merge, @lisse/react (squircle). Requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript. Home: https://ui.stepwise.studio. Docs: https://ui.stepwise.studio/docs/introduction. Quick start: https://ui.stepwise.studio/docs/quick-start. Repo: https://github.com/Stepwise-Studio/stepwise-ui. License: MIT (README License section + docs introduction + cli package.json license field; no root LICENSE file in repo). Pricing free.
